description: This Java class, EnterpriseApplication, serves as the entry point for launching an embedded Jetty server within a web application. It sets up server connectors, configures the web application context, and manages graceful shutdown handling.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class responsible for configuring and starting an embedded Jetty server for deploying a web application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The application entry point; sets up and runs the Jetty server with web context and shutdown hook.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Fetches the URL string of a resource using the class loader.

methods.name: getResourceFilePath
methods.description: Retrieves the filesystem path of a resource for Jetty configuration.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Determines the server port by reading a system property or defaults to 8090.
